segments.text: TEache me, O Lorde, the waye of thy ſtatutes: and I ſhall kepe it vnto the ende.
Geue me vnderſtandyng, and I ſhall kepe thy lawe: yea, I ſhal kepe it with my whole hearte.
Make me to goe in the path of thy commaundementes: for therin is my deſyre.
Encline my heart vnto thy teſtimonies: and not to couetouſnes.
O turne away myne eyes, leſt they beholde vanitie: and quicken thou me in thy way.
O ſtabliſh thy worde in thy ſeruaunt: that I may feare thee.

Take away the rebuke that I am afrayd of: for thy iudgementes
are good.
Beholde, my delite is in thy commaundementes: O quicken me in thy righteouſnes.
Glory be to the father, and to the ſonne. &c.
As it was in the beginning. &c.
